name: Marcus
label: Family plan splitter with household
who: I pay for a family plan that covers several people in my household, and splitting the cost is the main reason I use it. I care about each account keeping its own playlists and about the plan working smoothly for everyone.
value_for_money: Positive: they describe the family plan as pretty cheap per person and worth it, especially when several people split the cost. Duo and family plan setup issues are the main complaint, not the price itself.
loyalty: Keeps them on Spotify: the family plan split across several people and the fact that each account stays independent. Things that would push them elsewhere: being forced into a plan they do not need, and fear of losing playlists when switching plans. One user moved to Tidal after transferring their data.
pain_points: Being forced onto a duo or family plan
Fear of losing playlists when switching plans
Household address checks for family plans
likes: Family plan split across several people
reasons_to_stay: They keep Spotify because the family plan lets several people share the cost, which they describe as worth it and pretty cheap per person. Each member keeps an independent account, so the setup is reliable once it is running.
tone: Practical and matter-of-fact, focused on logistics and how the plan works.
